summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and added rich.align.VerticalCenter, per the spec. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Expected risk: existing snapshot tests for auto-width renderables inside Align may change, and the VerticalCenter render test assumes print adds no trailing newline. No commits made.
